uncertainties.meaning: Whether the mobile collection drive operates as scheduled every day from 9 AM to 5 PM without any disruptions (e.g., holidays, closures, or reduced hours) during the week of July 20-24, 2026.
Whether the average collection rate of 12 usable units per hour holds exactly for each hour the drive is open, or if there is variability that could affect total collected units.
Whether the hospital uses any blood units between Monday 9 AM and Friday noon, which would reduce the count of usable units on hand.
Whether the centre's initial stock of 40 units at 9 AM Monday is accurate and whether any units are added or removed before the Tuesday shipment.
Whether there are any other shipments from the centre to the hospital besides the scheduled Tuesday and Thursday shipments, or any returns or transfers that affect inventory.
Whether the Tuesday and Thursday shipments depart exactly at 4 PM and arrive exactly 3 hours later (7 PM), and whether the hospital receives them before Friday noon.
